parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The current page number. The default value is **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: StudioId
parameters.description: The ID of the template to filter. This parameter is optional.

parameters.name: StudioName
parameters.description: The name of the virtual studio template.
